frames.gloss: （我/我们/任何人）很乐意做某事——口语礼貌允诺套语
frames.pattern_notes: 固定骨架：would/d 缩约式 + be + happy + to 不定式，槽位仅主语与动词短语。口语讲座/陈述结尾高频的意愿表达。误读点：I'd 缩约式常被误读为 I had，读慢或读错；学习者产出时易漏 be 说成 *I'd happy to。属自然口语语篇。注：清单已有 find+O+补语、make sure that 等，但本套语不在清单内。

examples.s: If you're interested in reading our more comprehensive findings, we've produced detailed graphic representations on the college web-site and of course any of the group would be happy to talk to you about them.
Now, I'd be happy to answer any questions you may have ...

frames.frame: [A] (be) on the [increase/decline], [B] [be V-ing / be experiencing a resurgence] in [Y]
frames.gloss: 一方在增长/衰退，另一方呈相反趋势（常用于两地对冲对比）
frames.pattern_notes: 骨架：on the increase / on the decline 为固定介词短语作表语或前置状语，后接另一主语相反趋势，构成城乡/两地对比对冲句。误读点1：I02146 前置的 On the decline in the countryside 不是时间状语（'在乡村衰落期间'），而是 they 的表语前置（'它们在乡村正衰落'），学习者几乎必然误读。误读点2：resurgence 与 decline 的对冲关系需整存整取才读得快。

examples.s: Garden ponds are on the increase, rural ponds are disappearing, leading to massive migration to the towns.

On the decline in the countryside, they are experiencing a resurgence in urban gardens because these days gardeners are buying lots of different plants which means there's an extensive range of seeds around, which is what they feed on.

frames.gloss: 句首话语标记（顺便说/与此同时/好了）+ 逗号 + 主句，标记话题转换或补充
frames.pattern_notes: 骨架：连接副词死守句首+逗号位，槽位为主句。三例分别为 Meanwhile（时间承接）、Incidentally（离题补充）、Now（话轮收束/回到正题）。误读点最强的是 Incidentally（=by the way，学习者普遍误读为'偶然地/coincidentally'）；Now 句首作话语重启动词而非时间义也常读慢。属清单'to be honest插入语'的句首位置新变体；中位同族成员如 I02144 的 all in all。自然口语语篇。

examples.s: Meanwhile, we were doing our own observations in selected gardens throughout the city.
Incidentally, we discovered that a massive new survey on song thrushes is about to be launched, so you should keep an eye open for that.
Now, I'd be happy to answer any questions you may have ...

frames.frame: [主句] - [because / this time because / which / S V] 破折号追补
frames.gloss: 完整主句说完后用破折号追加原因、评注或解释——口语补充说明框架
frames.pattern_notes: 骨架：先给完整主句，破折号后接固定功能词 because / this time because / which 谓语 或独立小句，是对'主句， which 谓语'（逗号版，已在清单）和'同位语插入'（双破折号插入，已在清单）的句尾追补新变体。听力转写中破折号对应语流的停顿-补说，阅读者常把破折号误当插入语边界而读断主句，或把追补原因当成并列谓语读错主从关系。

examples.s: What we've decided to resent today is information about just three species - because we felt these gave a good indication of the processes at work in rural and urban setting s as a whole.
And there was a clear pattern here - they proliferate where there is suitable water.

Hedgehogs are also finding it easier to live in urban areas - this time because their predators are not finding it quite so attractive to leave their rural environment, so hedgehogs have a better survival rate in cities We had lots of sightings, so all in all we had no difficulties with our efforts to count their numbers precisely.
Another factor is the provision of nesting places - which is actually better in gardens than the countryside.

candidates.s: The first thing we did was to establish what proportion of the urban land is taken up by private gardens.
candidates.note: 'The [first] thing [S V-d] was to [V]'——名词性假分裂的 the-first-thing 变体（清单已有 What S V is B 假分裂）。骨架判据过、误读判据过，但本批仅 1 例，不满足≥2 句。

candidates.s: Just over 100 of them completed a survey once every two weeks for twelve months - ticking off species they had seen from a pro forma list - and adding the names of any rarer ones.
candidates.note: 'once every [数字] [时间单位]' 是清单'[数字] times a day/week'的新变体（间隔频率义，与 per 频率义不同），仅 1 例。另注意 '- V-ing and V-ing' 双分词追补（清单已有'主句， V-ing'）。

candidates.s: Why is it so popular with wildlife when the countryside itself is becoming less so?
candidates.note: 两处亮点：1) 'becoming less so'——代词 so 回指前文形容词（比较省略回指），误读判据过但仅 1 例；2) when 表对比而非时间（'而乡下自身却在…'），学习者会按时间状语误读。与第一波 'Why is it that [S V]?' 形似但结构不同（此处 it 为实指、无 that 从句）。

candidates.s: We deliberately chose smaller ones because they were by far the most typical in the city The whole point of the project was to look at the norm not the exception.
candidates.note: 'The whole point of [NP] was to [V]'（做X的全部意义就在于）——口语点题套语，骨架与误读判据均过，仅 1 例。另含 'by far the most' 最高级强化、'the norm not the exception' 先常后异对举。

candidates.s: The first species to generate a lot of interesting information was frogs.
candidates.note: 'The [序数词] [N] to [V] was [NP]'——序数词+不定式后置定语的枚举段开场句，与 I02145 'Our final species is...' 构成 first/final 呼应，但框架两侧虚词不同，算不算同一骨架拿不准，且枚举误读风险低，暂记候选。

candidates.s: Our final species is the finest of bird singers, the song thrush.
candidates.note: 最高级同位收束（清单已有'同位语插入'），列此仅备 first/final 枚举段呼应参考，见 I02141 注。

candidates.s: Well, so much that I just won't have time to tell you about here.
candidates.note: 口语省略残句（'内容太多，这里讲不完'），有趣但无完整骨架，且仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Our own informal discussions with neighbours and friends led us to believe that many garden owners had interesting experiences to relate regarding wild animal sightings so we decided to survey garden owners from different areas of the city.
candidates.note: 'led [O] to believe that [S V]'——lead sb to V 认知致使链，误读判据可过，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Hedgehogs are also finding it easier to live in urban areas - this time because their predators are not finding it quite so attractive to leave their rural environment, so hedgehogs have a better survival rate in cities
candidates.note: 'be finding it [比较级] to V'——清单 find+O+补语 的 it 形式宾语+不定式变体，仅 1 例；'this time because' 对比性原因连接语也仅此 1 例（已并入破折号追补框架作例）。

candidates.s: Alongside this primary research on urban gardens, we were studying a lot of books about the decline of wild animals in the countryside and thinking of possible causes for this.
candidates.note: 'Alongside [NP], 主句'——介词短语前置的平行工作框架，与第一波 'As well as [A]句首'、'Compared to/with [A], 主句' 同族的新介词成员，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Incidentally, we discovered that a massive new survey on song thrushes is about to be launched, so you should keep an eye open for that.
candidates.note: 'be about to be V-ed'（即将被启动）近将来进行被动，偏语法点（无独特骨架），列此备忘；'keep an eye open for [X]' 习语也仅 1 例。

candidates.s: If you're interested in reading our more comprehensive findings, we've produced detailed graphic representations on the college web-site
candidates.note: 'If you're interested in [V-ing], 主句'——礼貌条件引导套语，误读风险低（骨架弱），仅 1 例。
